_source: Closed-month totals for the 12-territory roster used by the weekly cards app. Jan/Feb are 11-territory sums from the dashboard's automation/forecast_data.py plus RIC-1 (Cesar Flores) numbers supplied directly. March is the 11-territory monthly_quota.json sum plus RIC-1 supplied directly (monthly_quota.json did not include RIC-1 for Mar). When a month is listed here, the generator uses these values instead of the snapshot sum.
